demos.heading: Before you run anything: set up the shell
demos.purpose: DocuMind can answer a tenant's questions from four stores: its own Vector Search index (the ANN tier), the Firestore rung beneath it, or two managed mirrors, Vertex AI RAG Engine and Vertex AI Search. make up pins acme to RAG Engine and zeta to Vertex AI Search so every store the course teaches is exercised. A managed store holds the text of every current version, but not the kit's addresses: its citations come back with ids like acme:acme_497809ff...#rag-532341da71fe, a page of null even for a PDF, and stages.retrieval_backend: rag_engine. This lesson's gate asks acme's golden rows, and lesson 11.1's dispatch judged the same candidate with acme on the kit's own index: pin it the same way for the duration, so the two verdicts are about one lane, and put the pin back at the end. Module 2 compares the four stores; Module 7 studies the mirrors.

demos.heading: make gate and make promote-gated, line by line
demos.purpose: commands/tests/test_release_gate.py plays every case on this page against a stand-in gcloud that keeps one lane's traffic table and revisions in a file. It calls nothing in Google Cloud and costs nothing; it starts a process for every stand-in call, so give it a minute or two.

demos.heading: On your lane: the candidate named, the token's audience, and the gate
demos.purpose: make record-candidate is the line make release-candidate ends with, run on its own. The cell then prints the traffic table and whether the file and the tag name one revision. The cell mints two tokens as documind-ui-sa, one for the canonical URL and one for the tag URL, and calls the tag URL twice with each: /version, which checks no token itself, and /v1/sources for acme, which goes through verify_iap and acme's roster but calls no model. About ten minutes: every golden row as the member, then the isolation rows again as the outsider. run_eval.py's own lines stream between the gate's two blocks; lesson 4.3 reads them.

demos.heading: Change it: a record that names another revision
demos.purpose: A copy of your record with one field changed, offered to make promote-gated through GATE_FILE. The cell copies your record to evals/reports/scratch-gate.json with one field changed: the revision, set to the one serving now. It offers the copy to make promote-gated through GATE_FILE, deletes it, and runs gate-check on your own record, which it never touched. The copy is green, fresh, judged by today's rules, and its report still hashes to its sha256: everything in it is true except the name.
